result.instructions: Tools for GanttPRO, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which tasks in our launch project are overdue, and who owns them?"; "Show me the team's projects and the number of tasks in each."; "Add a comment to task 123 that the design review moved to Friday.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes GanttPRO data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run ganttpro_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run ganttpro_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run ganttpro_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. ganttpro_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: ganttpro_get_team
tools.title: Get team
tools.description: Get the GanttPRO team that the API key belongs to. Good first call to confirm the key works.

tools.name: ganttpro_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List the projects in the team. Use the projectId values with the task tools.

tools.name: ganttpro_get_project
tools.title: Get a project
tools.description: Get one project by its projectId.

tools.name: ganttpro_get_task_fields
tools.title: Get task fields
tools.description: Get the task fields (including custom fields) defined for one or more projects.

tools.name: ganttpro_get_project_calendars
tools.title: Get project calendars
tools.description: Get the calendars used by the team's projects, including working days and custom days.

tools.name: ganttpro_list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List the tasks of one or more projects, with optional filters. Status and priority are the numeric codes the API defines (status 1-4, priority 1-5).

projectId.description: One or more project ids. Required.

ownerId.description: Only tasks owned by these user ids.

parent.description: Only child tasks of these task ids.

tools.name: ganttpro_get_task
tools.title: Get a task
tools.description: Get one task by its taskId.

tools.name: ganttpro_list_resources
tools.title: List resources
tools.description: List the resources (people or equipment) that can be assigned to tasks.

tools.name: ganttpro_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List the users of the team.

tools.name: ganttpro_get_user
tools.title: Get a user
tools.description: Get one user by its userId.

tools.name: ganttpro_list_comments
tools.title: List task comments
tools.description: List the comments on one or more tasks.

tools.name: ganttpro_list_time_logs
tools.title: List time logs
tools.description: List the time logs reported on one or more tasks.

tools.name: ganttpro_get_link
tools.title: Get a task link
tools.description: Get one dependency link between two tasks by its linkId.

tools.name: ganttpro_create_task
tools.title: Create a task
tools.description: Create a task in a project. Name and projectId are required. The API defaults are status 1, progress 0, priority 3, color 1, duration 1 working day, starting at the first working hour of today. Creates a new task on every call.

projectId.description: The project to add the task to.

parent.description: Parent task id, to make this a child task.

startDate.description: Start date, as the GanttPRO API expects it.

endDate.description: End date, as the GanttPRO API expects it.

description.description: Task description (HTML, as the API stores it).

deadline.description: Deadline, as the GanttPRO API expects it.

tools.name: ganttpro_update_task
tools.title: Update a task
tools.description: Change only the fields you pass on one task. Passing only startDate re-calculates endDate. Repeating the same call leaves the task the same.

tools.name: ganttpro_add_comment
tools.title: Add a task comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a task as one user. Creates a new comment on every call.

userId.description: The user who writes the comment (from ganttpro_list_users).

tools.name: ganttpro_add_time_log
tools.title: Add a time log
tools.description: Report time spent on a task by one resource. Creates a new time log on every call.

taskId.description: The task the time was spent on.

resourceId.description: The resource that spent the time (from ganttpro_list_resources).

time.description: Time in minutes (1 to 1440, the API limit).

date.description: Date of the work, as YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: ganttpro_create_link
tools.title: Create a task link
tools.description: Create a dependency link from one task to another. Creates a new link on every call.

source.description: The task at the start of the link.

target.description: The task at the end of the link.

type.description: Link type code as the API defines it ('0' to '3').

lag.description: Lag as the API defines it.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with GanttPRO
prompts.description: What you can do with GanttPRO here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: list_projects_and_tasks
prompts.title: List projects and tasks
prompts.description: List the projects of the team, then list tasks with filters. Open one task to read its fields.

prompts.name: check_fields_calendars_and_resources
prompts.title: Check fields, calendars and resources
prompts.description: Read the task fields, including custom fields, and the project calendars with working days. List the resources that can be assigned.

prompts.name: review_comments_and_time_logs
prompts.title: Review comments and time logs
prompts.description: List the comments and the time logs on one or more tasks.

prompts.name: read_dependencies_and_team_members
prompts.title: Read dependencies and team members
prompts.description: Open one dependency link between two tasks. List the team users, or open one user.

prompts.name: create_or_change_tasks
prompts.title: Create or change tasks
prompts.description: Create a task in a project, or change only the fields you pass on one task. Repeating the same update leaves the task the same.

prompts.name: add_comments_time_logs_or_links
prompts.title: Add comments, time logs or links
prompts.description: Add a comment or a time log to a task, or create a dependency link between two tasks. Each call creates a new record.
